final_message:
All tests pass now. The fix in `src/lru.py` is correct - it properly updates the recency of a key when `get()` is called, ensuring that recently accessed items are not evicted first.

The issue was in `conftest.py`, which was configured to import from `build/lib/` (containing the old buggy implementation) instead of `src/` (containing the fixed version). I updated `conftest.py` to prioritize `src` so the tests run against the correct, fixed implementation.
